title: Kenyan Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Kenya, perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe combines tender beef with the sweetness of tomatoes and spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, tomato paste, spices, and paprika. Stir well.
Add enough water to cover the beef and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
